records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Maple Systems* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: First project reached 2026-08-10 right after the getting started call [calendar:f7eb6ee0], so there is some momentum, but no invite, no key milestone, no customer reply to outreach [email:10055056], zero tickets, Starter plan, and only 8 days left. Silent single-admin accounts rarely self-activate.

draft.subject: Following up on our getting started call
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Great speaking with you last week, and nice work getting your first project set up. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so adding your real work into that project is usually the next step that makes things click.

If it's useful, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help to walk through your next step together?

Best,
Nadia
